title: CodeOS package manifest
description: Descriptor for a package stored under pkgs/. Source packages use type=source; already-packaged archives use type=binary with format=xora-1. Unknown fields are allowed so newer tooling can add metadata without breaking older readers.

name.description: Package identifier. Should match the directory name.

type.description: What the descriptor represents: source tree, prebuilt download, built archive, or tool.

category.description: Display group used by installers and app launchers (System, Graphics, Development, ...).

categories.description: Alternative tag list used by some manifests; prefer the singular category field in new packages.

dependencies.description: Names of packages that must be installed first.

provides.description: Virtual names or libraries satisfied by this package.

install_path.description: Absolute destination for the package payload, e.g. /bin/terminal.

source.description: Where the payload comes from: a relative directory, 'upstream', or a URL.

upstream.description: Original upstream download URL for a package that has since been ported to source.

format.description: Descriptor/archive format: xora-1 for built archives, ftech for converted prebuilt downloads.

port_status.description: Porting progress for packages converted from prebuilt-only descriptors.

size.description: Uncompressed payload size in bytes; for ported packages this is the original .ftech declared size.
